consentAccepted.title: Consent Accepted
consentAccepted.description: True if the user already accepted consent to share intake context with a human agent.

contextSummaryJson.title: Context Summary JSON
contextSummaryJson.description: JSON summary of the intake answers and context to share during handoff when context sharing is enabled.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Current SmartIntake session id. Pass from previous SmartIntake action output.

reason.title: Handoff Reason
reason.description: Reason the user or agent is requesting human handoff, such as user request, complex issue, or failed automation.

smartIntakeContextKey.title: SmartIntake Context Key
smartIntakeContextKey.description: Route key for SmartIntake. Set from $Context.Current_Page so Apex can resolve the template from routing metadata. Do not ask the user.
